text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Next up on Rem's research of fun activities to do on the summer beach was...
text_block_list.orig_text:
次にレムが
『夏の海』を体験しにやってきたのは──

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: It seems pretty lively here. So this is where the "Summer Festival" by the beach is held.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずいぶん賑わっていますね。
これが、
海辺の『夏祭り』
ですか。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Whether it's on the beach or in the ocean... I can see a lot of events that you can do in here. Sure seems like a lot of fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海の上でも
浜辺でも……
ここから見えるだけでも
多くの催しものが見えます。
とても楽しそうですね！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Yes! This summer festival has been going on for a while, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
この夏祭りは
しばらくの間開催しているんですよね？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I think Rem will set an eye on the kind of events here Subaru-kun and Sister might like!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルくんや姉様が気に入りそうな催し物に、
あらかじめレムが目星を付けておこうと思います！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, that said... what is that place?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ですが……
あそこはいったい？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: That corner is completely empty... There seems to be no events happening over there...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの一角だけ
ぽっかりと空いて……
なんの催し物もありません。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: How strange. I wonder if something's gone wrong...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか変ですね。
いったいどうしたのでしょうか……？

text_block_list.text: Ugh... It really is strange... Unnatural one could say...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うううう……
やっぱりおかしいよね……
不自然だよね……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: WHAT SHOULD I DOOOOOO!! HEY, HEY, DO YOU KNOW WHAT I SHOULD DO? WHAT, WHAT!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どーしよーーーー！！　
ねーねー、
どうすれば、
どうすればいい！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: P-Please calm down. What in the world happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
落ち着いてください。
いったい何があったんですか？

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: You see, we were originally supposed to hold a seaside fashion contest in this space, but... Ah, just so you know, I'm the organizer of this summer festival.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はさ、
元々このスペースで海辺のファッションコンテストってのを
やるはずだったんだけど……
あ、
俺、
夏祭りの主催者ね。

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Somehow I completely forgot to order ALL the stage equipment. The whole event just fell through suddenly today~ Isn't that surprising? Aaaahhh, I'm such a MORON!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとステージ機材の発注を丸っと全部忘れててさ。
今日になって急にイベントごとポシャッちゃったんだよね～
びっくりだろ？　
ああ俺のバカバカ！

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Moreover, this space isn't in the middle of the beach. It being empty and this widely open is just bad and looks bad. Man, what a blunder, what a problem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかもここ、
ビーチのど真ん中じゃない。
ここがぽっかり空いてるってのは、
大変よろしくないんだよな～
あ～
困った困った。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Um, if you don't mind...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
もしよろしければ。

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Really? Even though you were just passing by? Are you going to come up with a replacement plan for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと？　
通りすがりなのに？
なんか代わりの企画、
考えてくれんの？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I don't really have any good ideas at the moment... But the people of this town have always been so kind and looked out for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
現状いい案を思い付いているわけではないです……
ですが、
この街の方たちには
いつもお世話になっていますし。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Also, I want to invite everyone important to Rem to this summer festival. So we'll think together about what we can do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
レムの大切な人達を、
この夏祭りに招待したいんです。
なので、
なにかできることがないか、
一緒に考えましょう。

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: YOU-'RE-A-LIFESAVER!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た～
す～
か～
る～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, Rem and {0} quickly decided together to come up with an alternative plan for that event...
text_block_list.orig_text:
というわけで、
急遽イベントの代案を考えることになった
レムと{0}──

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: A seaside event at a summer festival that many people can enjoy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
多くの人が楽しめる、
海辺の催し物……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ... How about a race on the beach? You can feel the coldness of the water while racing, and it feels just right for the season.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……海辺でかけっこ、
というのはどうでしょうか？
競走しながら水の冷たさも感じられて、
ほどよく気持ちいいのではと。

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Far from feeling "just right", that's just called training! Young lady, don't you know how tough sprinting on the beach is?
text_block_list.orig_text:
気持ちいいどころか、
それじゃトレーニングだよ！
お嬢ちゃん、
砂浜ダッシュの過酷さ知らない？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I didn't think it was that bad when I ran while carrying driftwood on patrol the other day...
text_block_list.orig_text:
先日
パトロール中に流木を持ち運びながら走った時は
それほど過酷だとは思いませんでしたが……

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: So you're an athlete, huh...
text_block_list.orig_text: アスリートかいな……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: How about a contest where the winner is the one who can dig the deepest hole in the sand? Oh, however that'd be dangerous after, so partecipants have to make sure they fill it back in after digging...
text_block_list.orig_text:
砂浜を掘って、
より深い穴を作れた方が勝ち、
という勝負はいかがでしょうか？
あ、
危険なので、
掘った後にもう一度埋め直して……

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: That sounds like something someone in prison would do for fun...
text_block_list.orig_text: どこかの拷問刑ですかい……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: A boat race to the edge of the ocean...
text_block_list.orig_text:
海の端っこまで、
ボートで競争──

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: The ocean has an "edge" now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
海に端っこ、
ある？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...IT DOESN'T?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ないんですか！

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: ...Don't joke around. Eh? Wait... don't tell me you don't know how the sea's made?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あんたさ。
え、
もしかして海、
知らないの？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Well, it's not like I'm clueless about it, but... I can't say I know it down to the details.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと、
知らなくはないのですが……
詳しく知っていると言えるほどではありません。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: In other words, when it comes to the sea... I suppose I'm a rookie...
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり海については……
新参者
ということになります……

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: This is the first time I've heard someone refer to themselves as a "rookie to the sea". That boy that's with you over there is also deeply in thought with his arms crossed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海の新参者って、
初めて聞いたなおい。
そっちの兄ちゃんは腕組んだまま考え込んじまってるしよ。

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Hmm... So we're stuck, huh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～、
手詰まりか～……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I can't come up with any good ideas. I suppose this is due to Rem's shallow knowledge of the sea...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なかなかいい考えが浮かばないですね。
やはり
レムの浅はかな海の知識では……

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's fine, it's fine, don't bow your head like that. I wasn't counting on you pulling out a miracle from nowhere, and it was my mistake after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーいいよいいよ、
そんな頭下げないでよ。
元々あてにしてたわけじゃないんだし、
てか俺のミスだし？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it... This sand at my feet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
そうではなくて……
この、
足元の砂……

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: What's with the sand now?
text_block_list.orig_text: 砂がどうしたのよ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: If you look closely at it, you can see that it is very fine and smooth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よくよく見れば、
とても
粒子が細かく、
さらさらしています。

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: True enough. It's our local beach sand, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃそうさね。
浜辺の砂なんだから。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: If this sand has such properties... it may be possible to add moisture and make it harden like snow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この性質の砂であれば……
水分を含ませて、
雪のように固められるかもしれません。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Yes. I was thinking of ice sculptures, but using sand, therefore a sand sculpture!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
雪像ならぬ、
砂の像、
砂像です！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: A while back, when Lord Roswaal's mansion was covered in snow, we all made snow sculptures together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
以前、
ロズワール様のお屋敷が雪に覆われてしまった際、
みんなで雪像を作ったことがあるんです。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: If we made all kinds of things out of sand like we did back then at the mansion and then held a "contest" like Subaru had proposed, wouldn't the audience be able to enjoy themselves even without a proper stage for it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの時のように、
砂で様々なものを作って、
スバルくんが開いたように
『コンテスト』を開催すれば、
舞台がなくても
お客さんに楽しんでもらえるんじゃないでしょうか？

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: I see... Yeah... That's it!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど……
うん………………
それだ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The idea was immediately adopted. Participants immediatly gathered around and the sand sculpture making contest began.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイディアは即採用。
さっそく参加者が募られ、砂像作りが始まった。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: This is amazing! Despite the sudden announcement, it looks like a lot of people are partecipating!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいです！
急な告知にもかかわらず、
たくさんの方が参加してくれていますね。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: But... I wonder if it's okay if you and Rem can also take part in this contest...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが……
よかったんでしょうか。
レムたちまで、
参加させてもらって。

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: It's fine, VERY fine! This was all thanks to you guys. An invitation slot is a given. You can make whatever you want!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいのいいの！
全てはあんたたちのお陰なんだから。
招待枠だよ。
好きに作ってっちゃってよ～！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Well then, I guess we can't refuse such an offer...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでは、
お言葉に甘えて……

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Actually, aren't you already almost finished? Rem-chan, what did you make? Don't be shy, show me~
text_block_list.orig_text:
んん？　
ていうか既にほぼ出来上がってんじゃない。
レムちゃん何作ったのそれ。
恥ずかしがらずに見せてよ～

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: This was my first time making a sand sculpture, so there is still room for improvement...
text_block_list.orig_text:
砂で像を作るのは初めてだったので
まだまだ改良の余地はありますが……

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: It's okay, it's fi-... Wait! WHAT THE HELL IS THIS...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいからいいから……
──って！？　
なんだこりゃ……！？

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: THIS QUALITY IS AMAZING, OIII!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: もんのすげークオリティじゃねーかおい！！！！

text_block_list.name: Participants:
text_block_list.text: *Murmuring*...
text_block_list.orig_text: ざわざわ……

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Is this...a statue of a young man smashing a watermelon...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは……
スイカ割りをしている、
青年像……？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Yes. This statue is: "Subaru-kun looking cool even while enjoying his summer vacation"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
『サマーバケーションを満喫する姿もカッコいいスバルくん像』です！

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: What's with this sense of dynamism... The way the watermelon splits so realistically... Is this really made out of sand?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにこの躍動感……
リアルなスイカの割れ具合……
ほんとに砂で作ったのかよこれ！？

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Rem-chan... I think you're clearly the winner here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムちゃん、
あんた優勝だよ…………

text_block_list.name: Participants:
text_block_list.text: We can't compete with her...
text_block_list.orig_text: こりゃ勝てねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: E-Everyone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
み、
皆様……

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Very true. With this eye-opening idea for a contest and the use of sand during it, she's no rookie at all; she's a PRO of the sea!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
この目からウロコのアイディアといい、
砂使いといい、
新参者どころか、
海のプロだ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Rem is overwhelmed with emotion that everyone is so pleased with the Subaru statue she made...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルくん像で皆様が喜んでくださって、
レムは感無量です……！

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Come on～ 
Everyone, you too! Use Rem-chan as an example and make your own wonderful sand statue!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ～
みんなも！
レムちゃんのをお手本に、
いい砂像を作ってよ～！

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Wait, what...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──って、
あれ……？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうされましたか？

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Rem-chan, the place where you made that "Subaru-kun" statue... Could it be...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムちゃんがスバルくん像を作ったこの場所って、
ひょっとして……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Is there a problem with its location?
text_block_list.orig_text: 場所に何か問題でも？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Whooooooshhhh...
text_block_list.orig_text: ざっぱぁぁぁぁぁん。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: EEEKKK...! The waves...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっ……！
波が……！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Wh-why is this happening!? The shoreline was supposed to be much farther away than that! Could it be that the ocean is advancing on us...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なぜでしょう！？
さっきまで波打ち際はもっと遠くにあったはず。
まさか、
海が近づいてきた……？

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Rem-chan, don't tell me you... You don't know what the high tide is?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムちゃんあんたひょっとして、
満ち潮、
知らないのかい！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: High tide...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 満ち潮……？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Whooooooshhhh...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ざっぱぁぁぁぁぁん！！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Th-The sand statue of Subaru-kun...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ス、
スバルくん像が……！

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Rem-chan, the waves in the ocean ebb and flow, and that is why the shorelines moves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムちゃん、
海の波ってのはな、
満ちたり引いたりして、
波打ち際が移動するもんなんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Ahh, it's no good... There's nothing we can do about it now...! DON'T LOOK... AVERT YOUR GAZE...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
だめだ……
こうなっちゃもう手の打ちようがねぇ……！
見るんじゃない……
見ちゃだめだぁぁ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: A high tide... To think such a thing existed in the sea... To not understand something so basic... Rem is still a "rookie to the sea" after all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
満ち潮……
そんなものがあったんですね……
そんな基本的なことも分かっていないなんて、
やはりレムはまだまだ海の新参者……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: However this makes me feel like I need to learn more and more about the ocean...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もっともっと海について知見を深めなければと、
身が引き締まる思いです……！

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: She's so optimistic and humble, even though all that work has disappeared into the waves...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんだけの作品が波間に消えちまったってのに……
前向きで謙虚だなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Yes. This particular Subaru-kun statue will be remade. Even so, it was a good idea to make a lot of them just in case. I want everyone to enjoy the Subaru-kun statues for a while longer, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
こちらのスバルくん像は新たに作り直します。
それにしても、
念のためたくさん作っておいて正解でした。
まだまだ皆様にスバルくん像を味わっていただきたいので。

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: What did you just say? "A lot"...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんて言ったいま？
たくさん……？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Yes. One sand sculpture was not enough to express the charm of Subaru-kun in the summer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
夏のスバルくんの魅力を表現するのに
一体の砂像ではとても足りなかったので。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: You can see the other ones over there.
text_block_list.orig_text: 他のものはあちらに。

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: WHOOOAAAAA?! Statues of Subaru-kun, there's one, two, three... WHEN DID YOU EVEN MAKE THAT MANY?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぉぁっ！？
スバルくん像が、
いちにい、
さんしい……
いつの間にそんなに作ったの！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: This isn't "many" at all I might add!
text_block_list.orig_text: これでも全然足りません！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: From the right, "Statue of a strong Subaru-kun biting into a banana boat", "Statue of a stylish Subaru-kun savoring a tropical juice", "Statue of a gentlemanly Subaru-kun pouring a second glass of juice for Sister".
text_block_list.orig_text:
右から、
『バナナボートに食らいつく屈強なスバルくん像』
『トロピカルジュースに舌鼓を打つおしゃれなスバルくん像』
『姉様のためにジュースのおかわりを注ぐ紳士なスバルくん像』。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Then there's the "brave Subaru-kun statue who spilled his juice and was buried in the sand by Sister" and the "cute Subaru-kun statue who accidentally took a nap while buried."
text_block_list.orig_text:
それから、
『ジュースをこぼしてしまい
姉様から砂に埋められる勇ましいスバルくん像』
『埋められたままうっかりお昼寝をするかわいいスバルくん像』。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: There's even more coming! So you see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだありますよ。
あとは────

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Rem-chan... You might still be a "rookie to the sea", but... you're quite passionate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムちゃん……
あんた確かに海の新参者かもしんねぇが……
本気だな。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Rem has come here to tell everyone exactly what's fun to do during the summer! I'm looking forward to seeing what Subaru says when he sees those sand sculptures... I guess that's also part of it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムは夏の楽しみを正確にお伝えするために来ていますから！
スバルくんがこの砂像を見て
何と言ってくれるか楽しみ……
というのもありますけど。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Besides, I've made statues of Subaru-kun, of course, but beyond that, I've also prepared plenty of statues of my beloved Sister. I will explain each one. First of all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
スバルくん像はもちろん、
その向こうには
『敬愛すべき姉様像』もご用意しています。
ひとつずつ説明させていただきますね。
まずは──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Seeing Rem's seriousness, Subaru and the others will surely enjoy this summery event. Or atleast, that's what {0} was sure of.
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムの本気を目の当りにし、
スバルたちはきっとこのイベントを楽しんでくれる。
そう確信した{0}なのであった。
